chatgptPrompt:
Create a YouTube Shorts / TikTok cover, 9:16 (1080x1920). Keep the focal point and the text inside the centre safe area: clear of the bottom 25% and of the right-hand button column.
Subject: two bright neutron stars spiralling around each other, both fully in frame, thin lilac ripples of gravitational waves; a small gold ring in the foreground (an illustration).
Composition: the two stars in the upper centre, the gold ring small in the lower-left foreground, empty indigo night around; all inside the centre safe area.
Lighting and treatment: hot white-blue star cores with blue glow, gold ring (#F5D76E) rim light, indigo night (#0B0F2A), lilac wavefronts, shallow depth, subtle grain.
Mood: wonder.
Text: "2 stars." on one line and "1 ring." on the next in a clean geometric sans (Lexend style), white then teal (#4FE3C6), centred in the lower middle.
Scientific accuracy: neutron star mergers are thought to make some heavy elements such as gold; how much of the gold comes from them is still debated.
Avoid: no arrows, circles, faces with exaggerated expressions, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real news or NASA photo. It must read as a code-rendered illustration in the channel's look (indigo night #0B0F2A, teal #4FE3C6 light fronts, violet #5B3FD0).
Style: premium editorial science documentary, distinctive and art-directed, not generic AI art.
